description:
Passionate software developer and data analytics enthusiast focused on building clean, high-performance web applications and spatial tools.

Executing a solo project for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge—building a single-page dashboard that evaluates lunar landing sites using 3D mapping and terrain analytics.

Tech Stack: • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Three.js • Backend: Java Spring Boot (REST APIs)

Executing independently, but open to connecting and sharing ideas!
